cohort: The study included 70 pregnant women with multifoetal gestation at the Government Maternity Hospital, Hanmakonda.
finding: Multiple pregnancies are considered high-risk pregnancies, associated with more maternal and foetal complications than singleton pregnancies, with preterm labour being the most common complication and a leading cause of increased perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were performed in 64.3% of cases, with non-vertex presentation being a common indication for C-section (32.9% of C-sections).
